verdict.rationale: The justica.gov.pt Empresa Online service page lists exact euro amounts: 220,00 € for a pre-approved pact (440,00 € urgent) and 360,00 € for a founder-drafted pact (720,00 € urgent). It also states the payment methods and the 48-hour payment window, so the fees are published as figures rather than behind a contact form. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these published amounts match what is charged at checkout.
